definitions.explanation: The physical right arm of the body.
A person's most trusted and capable assistant or subordinate. Used figuratively, similar to English "right-hand man."

examples.japanese: {右腕|みぎうで}を{怪我|けが}した。
{右腕|みぎうで}に{力|ちから}を{込|こ}めてボールを{投|な}げた。
examples.english: I put all my strength into my right arm and threw the ball.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}がいなくなったら、{右腕|みぎうで}を{失|うしな}ったも{同然|どうぜん}だ。
examples.english: If he leaves, it will be like losing my right-hand man.

examples.japanese: {彼女|かのじょ}は{社長|しゃちょう}の{右腕|みぎうで}として{長年|ながねん}{会社|かいしゃ}を{支|ささ}えてきた。
examples.english: She has supported the company for many years as the president's right-hand woman.

examples.japanese: {監督|かんとく}の{右腕|みぎうで}と{呼|よ}ばれるコーチが、{選手|せんしゅ}たちの{信頼|しんらい}を{集|あつ}めている。
examples.english: The coach who is called the manager's right-hand man has earned the trust of the players.

notes:
USAGE:
The literal meaning (sense 1) is straightforward. The figurative meaning (sense 2) is very common and describes a person who is indispensable to a leader or organization. The figurative usage often appears with patterns like ～の{右腕|みぎうで} or {右腕|みぎうで}として.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {右腕|みぎうで}を{失|うしな}う (to lose one's right-hand man)
- ～の{右腕|みぎうで}として (as someone's right-hand man)
- {右腕|みぎうで}と{呼|よ}ばれる (to be called someone's right-hand man)
- {右腕|みぎうで}を{務|つと}める (to serve as someone's right-hand man)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {右腕|みぎうで}: right-hand man (most trusted person)
- {片腕|かたうで}: one's right hand (figuratively; same meaning as sense 2)
- {腹心|ふくしん}: confidant (trusted aide, more formal and literary)
- {側近|そっきん}: close aide (often in political contexts)
